changelog: Add 28-category taxonomy alignment, 3-tier collapsible tree structure, global playback rule enforcement, and per-show/movie rule overrides.
description: A Jellyfin plugin that scans media files for objectionable content using a local Ollama LLM instance. Scan results are stored as JCF sidecar files. During playback, flagged segments can be automatically skipped or muted based on per-category preferences.
name: Jellyfin Content Filter
overview: Scan and filter objectionable content using a local LLM
